description: Substrate identity contract for autoresearch fixtures. Single source of truth for what 'pristine seed' means. preflight + self_heal both read this; any drift in the seed against any invariant blocks the loop. Edit when re-capturing seed (add new allowed deps) or when a new past-agent artifact pattern surfaces (add to forbidden_*).

git.comment: Match by past-pollution FEATURE NAMES, not agent-template phrasings alone. The agent uses templates like 'Implement core ... for X' / 'Verify X for shipping' for BOTH legitimate fixture-A baseline (X = 'Developer Pulse Dashboard - MVP') and past pollution (X = 'Add current time button', 'Display loading spinner', etc.). Patterns here target the specific past-fixture feature names observed in pollution incidents. Add a new pattern when a new fixture's feature-name leaks into the seed. The 'Add ' prefix narrows agent-template matches to past-fixture additions (B/C/D/E features that should NOT exist in the pristine seed; A's dashboard is the baseline).

deps.comment: Modules from upstream ~/Builder-Workspace/devpulse/requirements.txt. These must be importable in the seed .venv for pytest --collect-only to succeed before any fixture B-E iter. Source: P17 incident (jinja2 + pytest_asyncio missing burned $5/1.5h). Fixture features that ADD persistence (sqlalchemy, alembic) pull those in per-task; they are not pristine-required.

db.comment: Builder execution-state tables that must be empty in pristine state. Populated by prior agent runs (P18: 53 agent_runs found). restore_seed in run.py wipes these; manifest verifies.

files.comment: Files left by prior fixture-A/B/C iterations. If present in seed, the agent sees a feature already implemented and the fixture test is invalid.

contract_surfaces.comment: Builder CLI surfaces the harness (scripts/autoresearch/run.py) consumes. Drift here = silent failures in harness (P1-P15 class). Verified by test_harness_contracts.py. ONLY runnable when invoked from an initialized Builder workspace; from source repo (no .agent-builder/), contract tests skip with `not_in_workspace`.

preflight_workspace_check.comment: Run first; if doctor reports ok:false, skip remaining contract tests (caller is not in a Builder workspace).

builder_board_show.comment: run.py:430 reads board state for gate_pass_rate. Top-level keys are column names; 'counts' aggregates.

builder_metrics_show.comment: run.py:870 (P15 fix) reads metrics['optimization_summary'] for composite formula. Top-level keys are flat metric names.

builder_logs_error.comment: run.py:433 reads error tail. May return {ok:false} when no errors exist or workspace lacks log volume; that's fine.

builder_logs_analyze.comment: M2.3 session-scoping invariant; harness gates against this. session_scoped MUST be true (post-2026-05-23 commit a3354c2).

builder_backlog_task_list.comment: Standard Builder envelope: {ok, status, results, ...}. 'results' is the task array.
